scope: body motion state input, parent-child transform and transition recovery; no object asset work
applicability: Bounded reference for existing creature body special-state blending and attachment inheritance. Not a proposal to give Dynasty an extra rolling skill, alter damage or copy body silhouette. A specific unfinished Dynasty asset is not selected for production in this research batch.

creation.entity: Constructor creates custom movement control. defineSynchedData sets ROLLING and ANGRY false. rollProgress/prevRollProgress/counter/clientRoll default0; maxRollTime50, rollDelta unset. Renderer creates ModelRockyRoller.
creation.skeleton: 128x128 declaration; root→body→head,tail,4limbs and spike planes. Body18x16x20 is main mass, limbs connect to same parent. Body roll therefore affects all children; no independent segment simulation.

state_producer: Idle goal starts30..59ticks rolling when grounded with a forward drop, no target and cooldown0. Goal reports canContinue=false; roll state continues at entity level, not tied to goal remaining active.
Melee goal selects approach position with world block/raycast checks, then turns to enemy and starts30..69ticks rolling. Goal.stop resets rollTimeout only, not rollFromPos nor ROLLING.
Server updates ANGRY from alive target within20blocks. Losing target suppresses angry contact behavior but does not immediately cancel rolling; roll continues until own stop rules.
rollFor sets maxRollTime, clears earthquakeCooldown and raises synced ROLLING only when rollCooldown0. No Citadel keyframe animation/event API in this direct chain.
motion_consumer: tick saves prevRollProgress then increments/decrements rollProgress between0 and5 according to synced boolean, giving a5tick pose blend.

handleRoll increments counter on both sides; on server first tick locks yaw and captures current horizontal velocity plus forward0.35(adult)/0.2(baby), initialY0.27. Later ticks keep captured horizontal velocity and currentY, lock body/head yaw.

Time exceeds maxRollTime: server clears rolling, cooldown10..19, counter0, velocityZERO. If counter>2 and velocity²<=0.02, or dead, tick clears rolling. Non-active branch sets stepheight0.66 and counter0; active uses1.0.

Body collision delegates ICustomCollisions.getAllowedMovementForEntity; that Citadel implementation is missing/unread. Entity permits pointeddripstone passage. Movement controller does query support shape and path type for jumping/steering, but that is ENTITY movement, not animated bone collision.
model_consumer: setupAnim first resetToDefaultPose. Interpolates prev/current progress; walkProgress=5-rollProgress. Body shifted+6Y through blend; arms/tail receive walking adjustments from walkProgress*limbSwingAmount.
During rolling bodyX=(rollCounter+partial)*0.2*progress*0.2; stores bodyX into entity.clientRoll and adds bob. It is time-driven visual rotation, not distance/ground-normal integration.

During unroll bodyX=progress*0.2*radians(wrapDegrees(degrees(clientRoll))). As progress returns0, body angle returns0 regardless of saved visual angle. clientRoll itself is not explicitly cleared; default-pose reset prevents additive accumulation.
Idle tail/head/arm oscillations and leg gait still added after roll branch. No claim that limbs are locked or physically tucked, no exact intersection/ground-contact guarantee without render.

Head yaw and half headpitch remain procedural; child transforms inherit whole body rotation. An attachment interface would need to read the final composed bone transform, not only raw entity yaw. No weapon/object implementation added.
renderer_consumer: RenderRockyRoller binds exact ModelRockyRoller and selects ROLLING texture first, otherwise ANGRY, otherwise normal. scale hook empty. This proves reference-path selection, not actual PNG appearance: PNGs not opened.
contact_boundary: Entity angry+alive rolling branch checks living entities in inflated boundingbox0.3, applies damage/push and extends target hit end to counter+10. No limb/mesh contact frame.
Unlike handleRoll inner movement block, the outer contact loop lacks an explicit !isClientSide guard in this class. Do not claim server-only authoritative damage or copy it into Dynasty.
Horizontal collision may call earthquake server-side; it uses world block queries and mobgriefing. That effect is unrelated to a per-bone contact solver and is not proposed for Dynasty.
stop_invalid_reload: Fixed duration, stalled velocity or death stop pose state; losing target alone is not stop. Goal.stop alone is not complete body lifecycle cleanup.

No custom NBT save/load overrides in this whole class, so its rolling flag/clock/visual angle are not explicitly persisted here. A newly constructed instance starts defaults; superclass/network behavior not fully read. Do not promise mid-roll reload continuity.
Only booleans synced in this class, not counter/progress/clientRoll. A late observer may ramp its own local progress and clock; exact phase equality unproven.
No explicit teleport or render-gap reset. During no-render period clientRoll may be stale for unroll. No Java/game/full animation playback performed.

Citadel default-pose/interpolation helpers and collision implementation unavailable locally. Native MobRenderer recursive behavior not re-read this batch. Direct consumer chain complete at these four classes, dependency/runtime gates remain open.

counting.rule: One creature family at most; four files, texture states, goals and bone children not extra references. Earlier accepted credit preserved. No claim applicable1000 reached.

independent_acceptance_required: Verify cached pin/blob agreement and actual reviewed scopes
Review relevance to a named still-unfinished Dynasty body task before credit/adoption
Resolve collision/default-pose framework dependency if claiming its behavior
Separately verify stop/death/target loss/late observer/reload/render gap
No production until applicable1000 gate accepted
